title: Leaves of the Wild Wood

readiness.reading: pre-reader friendly; all text can be read aloud

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: Under the old trees, the ground is covered in leaves. Look: no two trees have quite the same leaf.

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: Can you find three different kinds, and sort them by their shape?

steps.speaker: narrator
steps.prompt: Put each leaf in the basket with leaves of the same shape.
steps.hint: Look at the edges: wavy, pointy, or smooth and round?

feedback.mismatch: Compare the edges. Is it wavy, pointy, or round?
feedback.all_good: Three kinds of leaves, from three kinds of trees!

outro.speaker: narrator
outro.text: God made every tree its own way, and every leaf too. Can you find which tree each one fell from?

journal_line: In the wilderness I sorted fallen leaves by their shapes.
unavailable_text: The leaves are sorted for today.
